objective: Keep GitHub as source control, review, approval, and status aggregation while preventing GitHub Actions from becoming the only execution runtime.
principles: All non-trivial CI, QA, migration, and deploy logic must be runnable through versioned repository scripts.
GitHub Actions should orchestrate portable commands rather than contain long operational shell programs.
Browser QA must be selected by affected surface; shared shell, browser infrastructure, migrations, and runtime changes remain full-gate triggers.
Artifacts are uploaded on failure or for explicitly requested release evidence, not on every successful browser run.
Normal staging releases reuse existing secrets; secret mutation requires an explicit input.
Production promotion retains immutable SHA checks, human/environment approval, rollback readiness, and post-deploy verification.
Old execution paths remain available until the replacement has passed parallel verification.
migration_order: Make GitHub Actions a thin caller while preserving check names and guards
Run old and new paths in parallel where state mutation is involved
Move provider-native build and browser execution only after release identity and rollback evidence match
Retain an Actions emergency fallback after provider-native activation
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not remove production verification to save runner minutes.
Do not move database migrations into an unapproved automatic branch build.
Do not use self-hosted runners as the sole replacement runtime.
Do not delete legacy/fallback deploy paths in the same change that introduces their replacement.
